reviews.text:
We used their pet hotel service 🐶
They sent us daily emails with cute photos, and they even had a camera, so we felt very at ease leaving our dog there!
All the staff were very kind! …

The staff were all very kind and I was able to leave my dog ​​there for a week without any worries. 
The facilities were also excellent, and he seemed more comfortable there than at home, as he was feeling a bit down when he left...

The grooming was also great, and cheaper than other places.

I needed to leave my 15-year-old Toy Poodle for 8 nights, but the hotel I usually used wouldn't accept him due to his age. I tried this facility for the first time because they said they would take care of senior dogs. They kindly took care of his frozen food, medication, and supplements, and I felt at ease knowing I could check on him 24 hours a day via the cameras in each room. The staff were all very kind, and they carefully observed each dog's characteristics to find a good match for him to play with. My family was delighted when he came back looking younger than before we left!

I previously used their services for a long stay of over a week.

Being able to check on my child via camera gave me peace of mind while traveling.

The staff even came to take care of my child late into the night. I was so happy to see my child's expressions I'd never seen before in the daily LINE messages!

I will definitely use their services again.

I entrusted them with the care of my elderly dog ​​with multiple chronic illnesses, but they did not properly follow the instructions and precautions I provided in writing. Although they said my dog ​​ate some of the food I brought, when it was returned to me, it was completely untouched. The care report was also incomplete, and overall, I was very disappointed with their service.

Hmmm.

It seems good, and it's been about four months since my regular vet recommended it, but even when I check for appointments a month in advance, it's always fully booked around weekends...

Isn't it a bit too difficult to get an appointment?
